title: ficus johannis subsp. afghanistanica
intro: Ficus johannis subsp. afghanistanica, commonly known as the Afghan fig, is a subspecies of fig plant native to Afghanistan. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions and has been reported to have potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ficus johannis subsp. afghanistanica are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
